title: A&E for Construction of the New Kathleen Government Center in Polk
short_description: Design services for a new 75,000-square-foot government center on a 27-acre site.
project_scope: New Kathleen Government Center on a 27-acre county-owned site in Lakeland, Florida. The project includes a new 75,000-square-foot government facility as well as walking trails, green space, a playground, and other community spaces.
services: Architectural and engineering services with the architectural firm as prime consultant; requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, civil engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Public government building, which is generally less aligned with sbp's core focus than bridges, long-span roofs, or special structures.
- Includes structural engineering within a reasonably large new-build project.
- No indication of unusual spans, lightweight structures, innovative materials, or architecturally exceptional structural challenges.
- Outdoor site elements are secondary and do not suggest a technically demanding structural scope.
- Early design-stage A&E procurement offers some strategic entry potential, but overall fit remains moderate to low.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Available scope information for estimating: new 75,000-square-foot government building on a 27-acre site with trails, green space, playground, and community spaces. A rough market-based estimate could be in the range of 30000000 to 50000000 USD depending on specification and site development, but this is not stated in the tender documents.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the source. Useful basis for a rough fee estimate: full A&E design for a 75,000-square-foot public building including architecture, interiors, programming, civil, and structural engineering. Without a stated construction budget and procurement fee basis, no reliable sbp fee can be derived.
references_qualifications: The source does not state specific reference or qualification requirements. It indicates selection of an architectural firm as prime consultant for architecture and engineering services.
